# JellyGlance v1.2.3 Beta 3

## Release Summary

This beta expands third-party integrations and gives the core UI a much broader polish pass across settings, requests, activity, statistics, and user management.

### User-Facing Changes

- Expanded `3rd party apps` with Wizarr for invites, Tdarr for transcodes, Maintainerr for cleanup, and SickChill as a Sonarr alternative.
- Refreshed Settings with grouped categories, a collapsible sidebar, and dedicated custom kiosk controls.
- Added custom kiosk options for title, density, theme, visible widgets, widget sizes, and widget ordering.
- Improved Hall of Fame styling and expanded widget ordering customisation on Home and Kiosk layouts.
- Improved Requests with richer media cards, newer request features, and more advanced management controls.
- Redesigned `/activity` for cleaner browsing and improved `/statistics` with stronger summaries and clearer presentation.
- Added font weight options in the profile modal and moved logout into the profile modal flow.
- Improved list view options in Libraries and overhauled Users for a cleaner, more flexible UI.
- Added the option to hide users from stats and activity views when needed.

Closes: #64, #50, #31
